title.zh: 修正第183号法案第六十四节（题为《马尼拉市建制法》）的法案，延长拖欠临街税缴付免罚及免息期限，并豁免已产生的罚金与利息
title.en: AN ACT AMENDING SECTION SIXTY-FOUR OF ACT NUMBERED ONE HUNDRED AND EIGHTY- THREE, ENTITLED "AN ACT TO INCORPORATE THE CITY OF MANILA," BY EXTENDING THE TIME WITHIN WHICH PAYMENT OF DELINQUENT FRONTAGE TAXES MAY BE MADE WITHOUT SUFFERING A PENALTY AND INTEREST FOR NONPAYMENT, AND REMITTING PENALTIES AND INTEREST ALREADY INCURRED.
title.orig: AN ACT AMENDING SECTION SIXTY-FOUR OF ACT NUMBERED ONE HUNDRED AND EIGHTY- THREE, ENTITLED "AN ACT TO INCORPORATE THE CITY OF MANILA," BY EXTENDING THE TIME WITHIN WHICH PAYMENT OF DELINQUENT FRONTAGE TAXES MAY BE MADE WITHOUT SUFFERING A PENALTY AND INTEREST FOR NONPAYMENT, AND REMITTING PENALTIES AND INTEREST ALREADY INCURRED.
title.vi: Đạo luật sửa đổi Điều 64 của Đạo luật số 183 nhan đề 'Đạo luật thành lập Thành phố Manila' bằng cách gia hạn thời hạn nộp thuế mặt tiền quá hạn mà không bị phạt và tính lãi do không nộp, đồng thời miễn trừ các khoản phạt và lãi đã phát sinh
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแก้ไขมาตรา64ของพระราชบัญญัติฉบับที่183เรื่องพระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งนครมะนิลาโดยขยายระยะเวลาการชำระภาษีหน้าร้านที่ค้างชำระโดยไม่ถูกปรับและไม่คิดดอกเบี้ยสำหรับการไม่ชำระและยกเว้นโทษปรับและดอกเบี้ยที่เกิดขึ้นแล้ว
title.id: Undang-Undang Mengubah Pasal 64 Undang-Undang Nomor 183 berjudul 'Undang-Undang Pendirian Kota Manila' dengan memperpanjang jangka waktu pembayaran pajak frontage yang tertunggak tanpa dikenakan sanksi dan bunga karena keterlambatan pembayaran serta menghapuskan sanksi dan bunga yang telah timbul
title.ms: Akta Mengubah Seksyen 64 Akta Nombor 183 bertajuk 'Akta Penubuhan Bandaraya Manila' dengan melanjutkan tempoh bayaran cukai hadapan yang lewat tanpa dikenakan hukuman dan faedah akibat kelengahan pembayaran serta membatalkan hukuman dan faedah yang telah terkumpul

text.en:
The time within which payment may be made of delinquent frontage taxes for the years eighteen
hundred and ninety-nine and nineteen hundred without suffering the penalty and interest for nonpayment
provided in section sixty-four of Act Numbered One hundred and eighty-three, is hereby extended to March
first, nineteen hundred and two, and all penalties and interest heretofore incurred are remitted.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, February 20, 1902.
